chunks: Whatever is in it from Ḥakam ibn Ḥakīm, the nephew of Khallād, I have narrated from my father; and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah; and ʿAbd Allah ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allah al-Barqī, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥakam ibn Ḥakīm.

key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: al-Barqī; a nisbah identifying one of the transmitters
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: al-Ḥimyarī; a nisbah identifying one of the transmitters
key_terms.اِبْنِ أَخِي خَلَّادٍ: the nephew of Khallād; a distinguishing identifier for the narrator
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicating the author’s direct reporting of the chain
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: from his father; a link within the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Ḥakam ibn Ḥakīm in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Ḥakam ibn Ḥakīm, the nephew of Khallād, in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance is bibliographical and hadith-related, documenting the author’s route of transmission through recognized narrators.
